#### Description

When serving files through bottle, the WSGIFileWrapper class has its constructor arguments swapped, causing file operations to fail with AttributeError.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import bottle
from io import BytesIO

app = bottle.Bottle()

@app.route('/test')
def serve_file():
    # This should work but fails due to swapped arguments in WSGIFileWrapper

# Try to serve the file

    app.run(host='localhost', port=8080, debug=True)
```

When accessing `/test`, this results in an AttributeError because the WSGIFileWrapper tries to call methods on the buffer_size integer instead of the file object.

The issue occurs because in the WSGIFileWrapper constructor, the fp and buffer_size arguments are assigned in the wrong order, and then it tries to get attributes from buffer_size instead of fp.
